correctness.rationale: The local eight-offset rule defines exact 4-ary column maps. A complete 16-state and 256-state de Bruijn construction, with all local words exhaustively checked, gives exactly the enumerated cyclic SCCs. Two distinct SCC algorithms corroborate the finite certificate. Only the three separate directed four-cycles are new two-step returns, each with four spatial phases when circumference is divisible by four; the fixed-state core has characteristic polynomial \(z^2-z-1\) times \(z^2-z+1\). The explicit three-cell traveler translates by two columns every two updates and changes live count on odd steps, proving its least period. A separate full cell-by-cell program checks every configuration for widths 3 to 8.

value.rationale: The object is the smallest nontrivial fully periodic-height Life strip under literal eight Moore offsets. The exact global short-return classification reveals a sharp mod-four resonance with at most six two-orbits, despite a provably unbounded family of longer least periods. A finite local SCC certificate extends the claim to all circumferences, not merely a chosen range; its explicit fixed-state Lucas/six-phase count is a natural invariant. The result is limited to short returns and the specified multiplicity convention.
